classificationDefinitions.P0: Real Gemini: Strictly requires verified raw payload evidence file and originalHash. ONLY tier that can justify compatibility rules. (Currently 0 pending real session captures).
classificationDefinitions.P1: Standard Syntax: CommonMark / GFM or standard LaTeX syntax. Verifies integration with standard behavior.
classificationDefinitions.P2: Project Semantics: Exporter contracts (Canonical AST, diagnostics, asset mapping, payload serialization). Must pass unchanged.
classificationDefinitions.P3: Synthetic Robustness: Artificial edge cases constructed for testing. Non-blocking for parser migration.
classificationDefinitions.P4: Legacy Implementation-Specific: Tied to bespoke quirks/regex of old handwritten parser. To be retired/archived.
